plan.title: Verify environment and package versions
plan.description: Check installed versions of ultralytics, torch, torchvision, timm, pycocotools, ensemble-boxes. Install/pin ultralytics==8.1.0 if needed. Confirm GPU availability and VRAM.
plan.success_criteria: All critical packages at correct versions, GPU confirmed with VRAM reported

plan.title: Deep dive into dataset structure, annotations, and metadata
plan.hypothesis: Understanding the full dataset structure will inform model design choices
plan.description: Load data/train/annotations.json: count images, annotations, categories. Compute stats: annotations per image (min/max/mean), category frequency distribution, image dimensions. Examine bbox format, area, corrected flag, iscrowd. Identify the store sections from image filenames or metadata. Check category_id distribution — which categories are rare vs common. Check category 356 (unknown_product). Load metadata.json and understand its schema. Examine data/products/ structure (how many products have reference images, how many images per product, image sizes).
plan.success_criteria: Complete understanding of dataset: number of images, annotations, categories, image sizes, annotation density, category distribution, reference image availability

plan.title: Create train/val split, evaluation function, and YOLO data conversion
plan.hypothesis: A proper evaluation setup is essential before any training
plan.description: Install pycocotools, scikit-learn, ensemble-boxes. Create image-level 90/10 train/val split (seed=42), ensuring category coverage. Write COCO-format split JSONs. Implement eval function computing: detection_mAP@0.5 (all preds mapped to single class) and classification_mAP@0.5 (original category_ids), combined as val_score = 0.7*det + 0.3*cls. Convert COCO annotations to YOLO txt format for ultralytics (both nc=356 multi-class and nc=1 single-class versions). Create dataset YAML files. Verify with a dummy test.
plan.success_criteria: Split files created, eval function returns sensible scores on dummy data, YOLO format files verified

plan.title: Baseline: YOLOv8m nc=356 at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: YOLOv8m at 1280px establishes a solid multi-class baseline for this dense detection task
plan.description: Train YOLOv8m on train split with nc=356, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs, batch=16, close_mosaic=20. Run inference on val split, evaluate with eval function. This gives us both detection and classification baselines.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes, val_score > 0.1 (establishing a non-trivial baseline)

plan.title: YOLOv8x nc=1 detection-only at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it only needs to localize products without distinguishing 356 classes
plan.description: Train YOLOv8x nc=1 on single-class train split, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs, batch=8, close_mosaic=50. Evaluate detection_mAP@0.5 on val split. This will be the detection backbone for the two-stage approach.
plan.success_criteria: detection_mAP@0.5 exceeds the nc=356 baseline's detection mAP by at least 0.05

plan.title: Fix PyTorch 2.6 weights_only issue and train YOLOv8m nc=356 baseline
plan.hypothesis: Monkey-patching torch.load to set weights_only=False will allow YOLO pretrained weights to load, enabling training
plan.description: Add a monkey-patch at the top of main.py: save original torch.load, replace with a wrapper that forces weights_only=False. Then train YOLOv8m with nc=356, imgsz=1280, 100 epochs, batch=8 as the multi-class baseline. Evaluate on val split using our evaluation function.
plan.success_criteria: Training completes successfully and produces a val_score > 0

plan.title: Train YOLOv8x nc=1 single-class detector at 1280px
plan.hypothesis: Single-class detector achieves higher detection mAP since it only needs to localize products without distinguishing 356 classes
plan.description: With the torch.load fix in place, train YOLOv8x nc=1, imgsz=1280, 200 epochs, batch=8, close_mosaic=50. Evaluate detection mAP on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP@0.5 > 0.5 and higher than nc=356 baseline detection mAP

plan.title: Explore DINOv2 embeddings for product classification
plan.hypothesis: DINOv2 embeddings can distinguish between product categories using reference images and training crops
plan.description: Load DINOv2-base. Extract embeddings for: (a) cropped training annotations (sample per category), (b) reference product images from data/products/. Build a gallery. Measure kNN classification accuracy on val GT boxes with different k values and gallery compositions.
plan.success_criteria: kNN classification accuracy > 30% on val GT boxes

plan.title: Two-stage: nc=1 YOLO + DINOv2 kNN classifier
plan.hypothesis: Two-stage approach achieves higher val_score than end-to-end nc=356 YOLO
plan.description: Use nc=1 YOLO detections on val split. For each detection, crop from original image, extract DINOv2 embedding, kNN lookup against gallery. Evaluate full val_score (0.7*det + 0.3*cls).

plan.title: SAHI-style tiled inference for dense shelf detection
plan.hypothesis: Tiled inference improves detection of small/dense products by 3-5 mAP points
plan.description: Implement tiled inference: slice images into overlapping tiles (e.g., 1280x1280 with stride 960), run YOLO on each tile + full image, merge with NMS/WBF. Evaluate on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Detection mAP improves by at least 2 points over non-tiled inference

plan.title: NMS/confidence threshold tuning and TTA
plan.hypothesis: Tuning post-processing improves val_score by 1-3 points
plan.description: Sweep NMS IoU threshold {0.4-0.8}, confidence threshold {0.05-0.3}, and test TTA (augment=True). Find optimal combination on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves by at least 1 point over default thresholds

plan.title: Fine-tune DINOv2 projection head with ArcFace/SupCon loss
plan.hypothesis: Learned projection head improves classification mAP by 2-5 points over raw embeddings
plan.description: Freeze DINOv2, add 2-layer MLP projection head. Train with ArcFace loss on training crops + reference images. Evaluate classification improvement on val split.
plan.success_criteria: Classification mAP improves by at least 2 points

plan.title: Confidence gating: YOLO classes vs DINOv2
plan.hypothesis: Using YOLO class when confident and DINOv2 when uncertain improves classification
plan.description: For each detection, if YOLOv8 nc=356 confidence > threshold use YOLO class, else use DINOv2 kNN. Sweep threshold on val split.
plan.success_criteria: val_score improves over pure DINOv2 or pure YOLO classification

plan.title: Optimal model combination for 420MB budget
plan.hypothesis: The right combination of detector + classifier within size constraints maximizes val_score
plan.description: Enumerate feasible combinations considering 420MB limit. Test top combinations on val split. Check total sizes.
plan.success_criteria: Best combination identified and fits within 420MB

plan.title: Build complete inference pipeline (run.py)
plan.description: Assemble best components into run.py: tiled inference (if beneficial), best detector, best classifier, optimal thresholds. Test end-to-end on val split.

plan.title: Final ablation and sanity check
plan.hypothesis: Each component contributes positively to final val_score
plan.description: Run ablation: remove each component one at a time and measure val_score drop. Confirm every component is net positive.
plan.success_criteria: All components confirmed as net positive

plan.title: Package final submission
plan.description: Create submission with run.py, model weights, gallery files. Verify: total size < 420MB, correct output format. Test run.py with --input and --output args.
